limits: Small bot-v-bot sample; no human TTK attribution or general AI superiority.

Observed first-targeted-shot timestamp may include misses/protection; not a guarantee of complete contact history.
Per-impact HP losses can exceed initial HP if native health increases between impacts.
Head flag is native material containing head; no visual/human client test.
No new 6/15-bot scaling regression, OFF build or real-client replication test.
